title: Freezer Sausage, Egg & Cheese Breakfast Burritos
description: Make-ahead breakfast burritos that reheat quickly before work.

steps.text: Brown sausage; scramble eggs in butter.
Divide sausage, eggs, and cheddar among tortillas, roll tightly, cool, and freeze.

cookSteps.text:
BROWN:
{{q2}} breakfast sausage

Drain if needed.

SCRAMBLE:
{{q1}} eggs
IN:
{{q4}} butter

DIVIDE among:
{{q0}} tortillas
ADD:
{{q3}} cheddar

Roll tightly. Cool before freezing.

storage: Freeze individually up to 2 months. Microwave from thawed or frozen until piping hot.

title: Freezer Egg & Cheese English Muffin Sandwiches
description: Simple make-ahead egg-and-cheese sandwiches for grab-and-reheat mornings.

steps.text: Cook eggs in butter and toast muffins lightly.
Build sandwiches with egg and cheese; cool, wrap, and freeze.

cookSteps.text:
COOK:
{{q1}} eggs
IN:
{{q3}} butter

LIGHTLY TOAST:
{{q0}} English muffins

BUILD each muffin with egg and:
{{q2}} cheddar slices

Cool completely before wrapping.

storage: Freeze up to 2 months; reheat until piping hot.

title: Basic Weekday French Toast
description: Straightforward French toast from ordinary sandwich bread.

steps.text: Dip bread and cook in butter until golden on both sides.

cookSteps.text:
WHISK:
{{q1}} eggs
{{q2}} milk
{{q3}} cinnamon

MELT:
{{q4}} butter
DIP AND COOK:
{{q0}} bread

Cook first side until golden.
FLIP and cook second side until golden.

storage: Refrigerate up to 3 days or freeze up to 1 month.

title: Everyday Pancakes
description: A small dependable batch of ordinary fluffy pancakes.

steps.text: Mix dry ingredients, then stir in milk, egg, and butter just until combined.
Cook pancakes on a hot skillet until bubbles form; flip and finish.

cookSteps.text:
MIX:
{{q0}} flour
{{q1}} sugar
{{q2}} baking powder
{{q3}} salt
STIR IN:
{{q4}} milk
{{q5}} egg
{{q6}} melted butter
COOK pancakes until bubbles form and edges look set.
FLIP and cook until golden.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months.

title: Everyday Waffles
description: Crisp homemade waffles that freeze well for work mornings.

steps.text: Cook in a preheated waffle iron until crisp.

cookSteps.text:
MIX:
{{q0}} flour
{{q1}} sugar
{{q2}} baking powder
STIR IN:
{{q3}} milk
{{q4}} egg
{{q5}} melted butter
COOK batches in preheated waffle iron until crisp and golden.

storage: Freeze cooled waffles up to 2 months; reheat in toaster.

title: Cheddar Egg Breakfast Quesadillas
description: Scrambled eggs and cheddar folded into crisp tortillas.

steps.text: Scramble eggs in half the butter.
Fill tortillas with eggs and cheddar and toast in remaining butter.

cookSteps.text:
SCRAMBLE:
{{q0}} eggs
IN HALF OF:
{{q3}} butter

DIVIDE eggs and:
{{q2}} cheddar
BETWEEN:
{{q1}} tortillas

Fold closed.
TOAST in remaining butter, turning once, until crisp and melted.

title: Sausage, Egg & Potato Breakfast Bowls
description: Make-ahead bowls with potatoes, sausage, eggs, and cheddar.

steps.text: Brown sausage and cook potatoes until crisp.
Scramble eggs, divide into bowls with sausage and potatoes, and top with cheddar.

cookSteps.text:
BROWN:
{{q1}} sausage

Remove to a plate.

COOK:
{{q0}} hash brown potatoes
IN:
{{q4}} oil

Stir occasionally until browned.

SCRAMBLE:
{{q2}} eggs

Divide eggs, potatoes, and sausage among bowls. TOP WITH:
{{q3}} cheddar

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days; reheat until piping hot.

title: Make-Ahead Hash Brown Breakfast Casserole
description: A familiar egg, hash brown, sausage, and cheese casserole for several workday breakfasts.

steps.text: Brown sausage and spread hash browns, sausage, and cheddar in a greased baking dish.
Whisk eggs and milk, pour over, and bake at 375°F until set.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. BROWN:
{{q2}} breakfast sausage

LAYER IN BAKING DISH:
{{q0}} frozen hash browns
sausage
{{q3}} cheddar

WHISK:
{{q1}} eggs
{{q4}} milk

Pour over casserole.
BAKE at 375°F until center is set and top is golden.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze individual portions up to 2 months.

{{q0}} oats
{{q1}} milk
{{q3}} peanut butter
{{q4}} cinnamon
TOP WITH:
{{q2}} banana
